decisions.reason: The ERC-721C marketplace and royalty-enforcement decision does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion, payment methods, buyer requirements, or primary-mint fulfillment.
The source changes secondary-marketplace royalty enforcement, not the allocation of proceeds from primary mints.
The token-standard and secondary-marketplace decision does not alter optional tipping on the primary mint page.
ERC-721C royalty enforcement does not change embedded-wallet provisioning, purchase confirmation, or fiat-buyer reward access.
The necessary change from checking Base ERC-721 ownership to Base ERC-721C ownership is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The existing FAQ statement that secondary sales carry a visible flat $10 royalty remains accurate; the source does not require the FAQ to describe ERC-721C or marketplace whitelisting.
Changing how the $10 secondary royalty is enforced does not alter the Small Block prize amount, draw condition, or rule that secondary royalties fund its pool.
Marketplace royalty enforcement does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, reset, or transfer behavior.
The ERC-721C and marketplace-whitelisting decision does not alter badge designs, referral milestones, storage, or effects.
The source changes the token standard and royalty controls but does not change which referral, ticket, or badge attributes must appear in NFT metadata.
The secondary-sale enforcement mechanism does not alter automatic prize transfer, payout destination, or winner-notification channels.
The source confirms a contract-level standard and marketplace policy but does not request any corresponding change to the About page copy.
